title: The arms of a keyed dispatch are IRIs minted from the table and the key
description: T's arms are <base>T.arm.ftyp.str and <base>T.arm.7.str for the string keys ftyp and 7, every string key carrying the suffix .str, and <base>T.arm.7 for the integer key 7, which never does; none is a blank node, and the lone sibling in on is bddo:dispatchOnField.
